minutes.headline: TCP committee heard community groups and reviewed four floor-plan options; layout and next meeting dates set, no votes
minutes.summary: The committee heard space needs from the Council on Aging, school administration, the Grange, the Lions Club food pantry and the cable access group (PAC), then reviewed four architect layout options for the TC Passios building. Members favored moving PAC to the back wing with exterior access and moving school offices to the town-office side. Meeting dates were set, a fall town meeting update article was planned, and the meeting adjourned by roll call.

public_comment.topic: PAC representative on studio space, kitchen studio, security and own budget for equipment
Asked whether existing plumbing will be replaced because of high lead levels in the building's kitchen water tests

votes.motion: Motion to adjourn at 8:40 p.m.; roll call taken

budget_items.what_was_said: PAC said kitchen studio equipment and cameras would come from its own budget funded by accumulated capital money, while the design should cover facility access.

budget_items.topic: Raising roof for PAC master studio
budget_items.what_was_said: The structural engineer said raising the roof would need new framing and lateral reinforcement and would cost more construction dollars.
The chair arranged a paid ledger ad; its cost was mentioned.
The architect wants a meeting to review a draft report and cost information by end of October.

decisions.decision: Consensus to flip the layout so PAC sits in the back wing with exterior access and parking, and school offices move to the town-office side.
Architects to send adjacencies by noon Monday; members to send comments via the chair by close of business Wednesday.
Added a meeting on September 29 at 6 pm.
Tentatively planned October 7, 14 and 22 at 5:30 pm, to be revisited at next meeting.
Fall special town meeting article will be a generic update presentation; draft language to be presented next meeting for a vote before the 29th.

what_happened.line: The committee reached consensus to flip the layout: cable access (PAC) moves to the back wing with exterior access, and school offices to the town-office side.
No votes were taken; members reviewed four architect layout options for the TC Passios building after hearing space needs from community groups.
A meeting was added for September 29 at 6 pm, and October 7, 14 and 22 at 5:30 pm were tentatively planned, to be revisited next meeting.
The fall special town meeting article will be a generic update, with draft language to come back for a vote before the 29th.
The structural engineer said raising the roof for a PAC master studio would need new framing and lateral reinforcement, adding construction cost.

why_it_matters: The layout chosen here shapes which town and school functions share the building and how much construction the project needs, which feeds the cost a future town meeting vote would be asked to fund.
Design choices such as a raised roof add construction cost, while PAC said its studio equipment would come from its own capital-funded budget rather than the building project.
